sql: SELECT DISTINCT fish_date_season, MAX(fish_date_doy) as max_doy, COUNT(*) as trip_count FROM trips GROUP BY fish_date_season ORDER BY fish_date_season DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trip_count, ROUND(AVG(yt / (anglers + 0.5)), 2) as avg_yt_per_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 330 GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls
